description: SongCore regression test closure: the full Common Formats capability set (MP3/FLAC/AAC/M4A/ADTS/ALAC/WAV/Vorbis/Opus) plus the Matroska demuxer, used only to construct the container-vs-stream metadata conflict fixture and the two-audio-stream Matroska fixture. This profile exists for the SongCore authority run; it is NOT a production closure. Capability intent is test-fixture-driven, not product-driven.

demuxer:matroska.reason: Test-only: Matroska is the only Common-Formats-adjacent container in the closure that populates BOTH container (segment) and stream (track) metadata, which the frozen canonical-precedence policy (selected stream overrides container) machine-tests. Never a production capability.

lib:swresample.reason: FFmpeg n9.0.1 configure hard dependency of the native Opus decoder. SongCore does not use swr.
